svg.title: AREA 44
svg.desc: Leave one player on the central pad. A gun user breaks rocks west while two clear east; activate both red switches and return via warps 2 and 3. After finishing the west path, help clear enemies in the east. After collecting the boxes, use only the right-hand switch from the entrance. Ignore the error sound; the other switch turns the lights off. Watch for ceiling traps by the rock-blocked boxes. The central-platform boxes require clearing the northern area and can be skipped. One holds the pad; the other three split up. Ranger west: clear the turrets, then break the rock ahead. Two Hunters take the east enemy route. Use only the right-hand switch from the entrance. Ignore its error sound; the other turns lights off. The central-platform boxes can be skipped. Ceiling traps guard the boxes behind the rocks.
